comment: PART 3 — THE COIN OF FATE (Round Three of the Legends' Monopoly Game, ~4:30). Group stage's final round. Messi/Ronaldo/Haaland/Mbappe score and are rewarded; the silent are caged; Dembele's hat-trick ties Mbappe -> witches' one-nation-one-seat law -> coin flip -> Mbappe stays, Dembele cast off the board (still alive in the real WC because all teams advance). Leaderboard + rivals hunting first. Soccer only, our-story (not real fact), free-to-play, no prizes.

lines.text: One coin. One spin. And the fate of a legend... decided in mid-air.
Round three. The final round of the group stage. And the board is starving.
Three legends walked in leading. Only goals will decide who walks out.
But tonight, the board breaks its own rule. And a hat-trick hero is erased.
Who scored? Who was caged? And who did the witches throw off the board... forever?
Round one, the board crowned Messi, and threw Ronaldo into a cell.
Round two, three witches stirred the dark, and Pele, the King, showed his face.
He freed Ronaldo. And the legend answered with two goals of fire.
Now round three begins. And every legend must score... or fall.
The dice roll. Messi moves first.
He does not run. He arrives. And the net finds him yet again.
One more goal. The board glows gold. Messi holds the summit.
Then Ronaldo answers, from the freedom the King gifted him.
The cell could not hold him. And now nothing can.
Haaland rises above them all, and heads it home.
Brick by brick, goal by goal, the wall climbs higher.
But the board shows no mercy to the silent.
Those who did not score are dragged, screaming, into the cells.
Kane still rots behind the bars. And the empty cages hunger for more.
Score, or the board devours you. That is the only law that remains.
And then... France breaks the game itself.
Mbappe scores. Of course he scores. The prince always scores.
But behind him, a shadow explodes into light.
Ousmane Dembele. One goal. Two goals... three.
A hat-trick. And suddenly, two Frenchmen stand equal upon the board.
But the board holds one law the witches will never break.
One nation. One seat. Only a single legend may carry France.
Mbappe... or Dembele. Both scored. Both deserve it. Only one can stay.
So the witches reach for the oldest judge of them all.
A coin. Gold on both faces of fate.
Heads, the prince. Tails, the challenger who came from nowhere.
The coin spins. The board holds its breath. Even the King looks away.
And it falls... on Mbappe.
The prince stays. The whole board roars his name.
And Dembele... fades from the board. Erased. Out of the game.
A hat-trick hero, cast into the dark, by nothing but a spin of gold.
Was it fate? Or did the witches weight that coin from the very start?
But hear this, and hear it well.
On the board, Dembele is gone. Out there, on real grass, he marches on.
Because every team has qualified. The whole World Cup rolls forward.
Not one legend is truly out. The real race carries them all.
So the board reveals the standings. The war for the Golden Boot.
Messi, six. Mbappe, five. Haaland, five. Ronaldo, four.
One single goal separates the throne from the pack that hunts it.
And every eye now burns with the very same hunger. First place... or nothing.
The group stage is over. The knockouts wait in the dark.
One question remains. And this one is yours to answer.
Who tops the Golden Boot? Who survives the cull? Who lifts the cup?
Messi? Mbappe? Haaland? Or Ronaldo?
Go to worldcup twenty-six dot world. Pick your three legends.
Free to play. For glory alone.
Drop your champion in the comments. Like, share, and subscribe.
The coin is still spinning. And the board... is always watching.
